mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpIvPrewarhsngOrderDetailPopList*/ SELECT B.INV_NO , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BEFORE_GR_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS BEFORE_GR_DATE , A.BUYER , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , C.INV_AMT AS TOT_INV_AMT , A.REQ_USER_ID AS PURCHASER_ID , A.REQ_USER_NAME AS PURCHASER_NAME , A.REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE AS PURCHASER_DEPT , ( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = C.BUYER AND CODE = A.REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE AND TYPE = 'C001' ) AS PURCHASER_DEPT_NAME , A.REQ_USER_TEL_NO , DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.WAREHOUSE_CODE,C.BUYER) --TR이면 물류센터가고객사 AND CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001',A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) --TR이면 물류센터의 배송지 정보 AND TYPE = 'C012' --해당 고객사의 배송지 코드 ), 0, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.WAREHOUSE_CODE,C.BUYER) AND CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001',A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AND TYPE = 'C012' ) ) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.ITEM_QTY , DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE , (DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) * A.ITEM_QTY ) AS INV_AMT , A.MAKER_CODE , A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , A.ORIGIN_CODE , A.ORIGIN_NAME AS ORIGIN_NAME , A.REMARK , A.PROCESS_TYPE , A.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT B , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVHD C WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BS_NO = B.BS_NO AND B.SELLER = C.SELLER AND B.INV_NO = C.INV_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.AGENT_CODE = #{st_com_code} -- 세션 COM_CODE AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} --파라메터 AND B.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} --파라메터
mapper.update: UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG SET DELIVERY_FLAG = 'P' -- N:초기값 I:송장생성 P:납품예정 Y:납품확정 , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE (BUYER, BS_NO ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, BS_NO FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVHD WHERE INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} ) AND DELIVERY_FLAG = 'N'
